description: Shape of the per-service JSONC config file <service-id>.jsonc in the proxy config directory. All keys are optional; a missing file means compiled-in defaults. A present-but-malformed file (bad JSONC, unknown key, invalid glob) is a hard startup error. Comments and trailing commas are allowed.

metadata.base_instructions: inline system instructions replacing the default agentic prompt for this model. Mutually exclusive with base_instructions_file; setting both is a hard error.
metadata.base_instructions_file: absolute path to a UTF-8 file whose contents replace base_instructions (inlined at load). Mutually exclusive with base_instructions.
metadata.enabled: per-model lockdown: false removes the model from discovery AND refuses requests naming it (403 model_not_enabled). Default true.
metadata.keys_naming_unknown_models: ignored, so stale entries do not break discovery when a provider retires a model.

metadata.upstream_base_url: override the upstream API endpoint (CLI flags take precedence over this, which takes precedence over compiled-in defaults).
metadata.enabled: service kill-switch: false disables the whole service even when the key is present. Default true; final enablement is this AND key-present.
metadata.model_exclude_globs: glob patterns matched against upstream model IDs; matches are dropped from discovery. Empty list disables filtering. '*' matches any run of characters (including none); no '**'; a pattern without '*' is an exact match; matching is case-sensitive. Overriding the list replaces compiled-in defaults entirely.
metadata.log_level: normal = startup banner, config line, discovery totals, upstream non-200s, fatal errors. verbose = additionally one line per relayed request (proxy id, per-process counter, requested model, upstream-reported model).
